dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Wow... So this iron ball could make such a huge hole...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's more like a rift than the entrance to a cave...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: If we can bring this thing back to the tribe, it will definitely be of great use.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: And what would you do, take Matriarch Babel out for a joyride?
